```{r read in excel on combine all sheets to one file, include=FALSE}
file <- "~/Desktop/Isabella/Clinical Data/RNAseq-CarTrans_Long_Clinical Data_ALL PATIENTS_Export.xlsx"

# Map together different sheets
sheets <- excel_sheets(file)

data_list <- map(sheets,
  ~ read_excel(file, sheet = .x)
)

names(data_list) <- sheets

# Convert them into individual data frames
purrr::map(names(data_list),
~assign(.x, data_list[[.x]], envir = .GlobalEnv)
)

str(data_list)

data <- data_list
```


```{r mutate data}

# Mutate factors and define different levels

## Clinical Data
data$`Clinical Data` <- data$`Clinical Data` |>
  dplyr::mutate(

    ### Short-term MCS
    Shortterm_MCS = dplyr::case_when(
      Shortterm_MCS %in% c("No", "NA.") ~ "No",
      Shortterm_MCS %in% c("VA-ECMO, Impella") ~ "Impella",
      Shortterm_MCS %in% c("VA-ECMO", "postoperative VA-ECMO") ~ "ECMO",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    ### Long-term MCS
    Longterm_MCS = dplyr::case_when(
      Longterm_MCS %in% c("No", "NA") ~ "No",
      Longterm_MCS == "LVAD" ~ "LVAD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    ### Sex
    Sex = dplyr::case_when(
      Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
      Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    ### Diabetes
    Diabetes = dplyr::case_when(
      Diabetes %in% c("No", "prediabetes") ~ "No",
      Diabetes %in% c("DM type 2") ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    ### Device
    Device = dplyr::case_when(
      Device %in% c("No", "NA") ~ "No", 
      Device %in% c( "CRT-D", "CRT-D, VSD Patch Plastic, aortic valve mechanic prosthetic",
                    "St.n CRT-D") ~ "CRT-D",
      Device %in% c("ICD", "S-ICD", "ICD-D") ~ "ICD",
      Device == "life vest" ~ "Life Vest",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Shortterm_MCS = factor(Shortterm_MCS, levels = c("No", "Impella", "ECMO")),
    Longterm_MCS  = factor(Longterm_MCS,  levels = c("No", "LVAD")),
    Sex           = factor(Sex,           levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    Device        = factor(Device,        levels = c("No", "ICD", "CRT-D", "Life Vest"))
  )

## Immunological Data
data$`Immunologic Data` <- data$`Immunologic Data` |>
  dplyr::mutate(

    ### Pirche Classification
    PIRCHE = dplyr::case_when(
      PIRCHE == "high risk" ~ "High risk",
      PIRCHE == "intermediate risk" ~ "Intermediate risk",
      PIRCHE == "low risk" ~ "Low risk",
      PIRCHE %in% c("NA", NA) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ PIRCHE
    ),

  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    PIRCHE = factor(PIRCHE, levels = c("Low risk", "Intermediate risk", "High risk"))
  )

## Immunological Data
data$`Transplantation` <- data$`Transplantation` |>
  dplyr::mutate(

    ### Donor transplant status
    HTx_status = dplyr::case_when(
      HTx_status == "DCD III" ~ "DCD",
      HTx_status == "DBD" ~ "DBD",
      HTx_status %in% c("NA", NA) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ HTx_status
    )
)

# Mutate class 
data$`Clinical Data`$BMI <- as.numeric(data$`Clinical Data`$BMI)
data$`Lab Data`$NTproBNP_BL <- as.numeric(data$`Lab Data`$NTproBNP_BL)
data$`Lab Data`$CRP_BL <- as.numeric(data$`Lab Data`$CRP_BL)
data$`Lab Data`$TropT_BL <- as.numeric(data$`Lab Data`$TropT_BL)

```

```{r rename columns}
data$`Clinical Data` <- data$`Clinical Data` |>
  dplyr::rename(
    "Shortterm Mechanical Support" = Shortterm_MCS,
    "Longterm Mechanical Support" = Longterm_MCS,
    "Pulmonary hypertension" = PH
  )

data$`Lab Data` <- data$`Lab Data` |>
  dplyr::rename(
    "NTproBNP at Baseline (ng/L)" = NTproBNP_BL,
    "CRP at Baseline (mg/L)" = CRP_BL,
    "Troponin T at Baseline (ng/L)" = TropT_BL
  )

data$`Immunologic Data` <- data$`Immunologic Data` |>
  dplyr::rename(
  "CMV Status" = CMV,
  "Pirche Score Overall" = total_PircheScore,
  "Pirche Classification" = PIRCHE
  )    

data$`Transplantation` <- data$`Transplantation` |>
  dplyr::rename(
  "AB0 mismatch" = AB0_mismatch,
  "Organ Care System" = OCS,
  "Donor Transplant status" = HTx_status,
  "Waiting time (d)" = waiting_time
  ) 

data$`Immunosuppression` <- data$`Immunosuppression` |>
  dplyr::rename(
  "Transplantation risk score" = Transplantation_risk)
    
```

```{r merge different lists into one dataframe}
clin <- as.data.frame(data$`Clinical Data`)
lab <- as.data.frame(data$`Lab Data`)
trans <- as.data.frame(data$`Transplantation`)
sup <- as.data.frame(data$`Immunosuppression`)
im <- as.data.frame(data$`Immunologic Data`)
echo <- as.data.frame(data$`Echo Results`)

# Avoid duplicates by removing overlapping columns before merging
lab  <- lab[ , !names(lab) %in% c("Sex", "Age", "DOB",  "Date_Transplantation")]
trans  <- trans[ , !names(trans) %in% c("Sex", "Age", "DOB",  "Date_Transplantation")]
sup  <- sup[ , !names(sup) %in% c("Sex", "Age", "DOB",  "Date_Transplantation")]
im  <- im[ , !names(im) %in% c("Sex", "Age", "DOB",  "Date_Transplantation")]
echo <- echo[ , !names(echo) %in% c("Sex", "Age", "DOB", "Date_Transplantation")]


# With merge only to dataframes can be merged, merging every dataframe sequentially
df <- merge(clin, lab, by = "ID", all.x = TRUE)
df <- merge (df, trans, by="ID", all.x=TRUE)
df <- merge (df, sup, by="ID", all.x=TRUE)
df <- merge (df, im, by="ID", all.x=TRUE)
df <- merge (df, echo, by="ID", all.x=TRUE)

# Sanity check
any(duplicated(names(df)))

# Remove duplicated CarTrans-Long-051
df <- df[!duplicated(df$ID), ]
```


```{r table1 for overall}
#Order by frequency
df$Diagnosis <- factor(df$Diagnosis, levels = names(sort(table(df$Diagnosis), decreasing = TRUE)))
df$Aetiology <- factor(df$Aetiology, levels = names(sort(table(df$Aetiology), decreasing = TRUE)))

caption  <- "Clinical characteristics CarTrans cohort overall"
footnote <- "* Hereditary: definite detection of gene mutation or congenital defect"


table1(~ Diagnosis + Aetiology + Age + Sex,
  data = df,
  overall = c(left = "Overall"),
  caption = caption,
  footnote = footnote
)

t1 <- table1(~ Diagnosis + Aetiology + Age + Sex,
  data = df,
  overall = c(left = "Overall"),
  caption = caption,
  footnote = footnote
)
```

```{r export in word, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# Convert to data frame
t1_df <- as.data.frame(t1)

# Convert to flextable
ft <- flextable(t1_df)

# Create Word document
doc <- read_docx()
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft)

# Save
print(doc, target = "table1_overall_short.docx")
```

```{r use library table1, fig.width=15, fig.height=15}

footnote <- "* Hereditary: definite detection of gene mutation or congenital defect"


table1(~ Aetiology + Age + Sex + `Shortterm Mechanical Support` + `Longterm Mechanical Support` + Device + `Diabetes` + `CKD` + `Pulmonary hypertension` +`Pirche Classification` + `Pirche Score Overall` + `CMV Status` + `Donor Transplant status` + `Organ Care System` + `AB0 mismatch` + `Sex mismatch`+ + `Waiting time (d)` + `NTproBNP at Baseline (ng/L)` + `CRP at Baseline (mg/L)` + `Troponin T at Baseline (ng/L)`|Diagnosis,
  data = df,
  overall = c(left = "Total"),
  caption = caption,
  footnote = footnote
)

t2 <- table1(~ Aetiology + Age + Sex + `Shortterm Mechanical Support` + `Longterm Mechanical Support` + Device + `Diabetes` + `CKD` + `Pulmonary hypertension` +`Pirche Classification` + `Pirche Score Overall` + `CMV Status` + `Donor Transplant status` + `Organ Care System` + `AB0 mismatch` + `Sex mismatch`+ + `Waiting time (d)` + `NTproBNP at Baseline (ng/L)` + `CRP at Baseline (mg/L)` + `Troponin T at Baseline (ng/L)`|Diagnosis,
  data = df,
  overall = c(left = "Total"),
  caption = caption,
  footnote = footnote
)
```

```{r visual overview heatmap, fig.height =7, fig.width=10, out.width="100%"}
df <- dplyr::filter(df, !ID == "CarTrans-Long-009")

# Choose variables for the annotations
annotation_df <- df %>%
  select(
    ID,
    `Transplantation risk score`,
    `Pirche Classification`,
    `CMV Status`,
    `Sex mismatch`,
    Diagnosis,
    Aetiology,
    Sex,
    #`Shortterm Mechanical Support`,
    #Device,
    #Diabetes,
    #`Pulmonary hypertension`,
    #CKD,
    `Donor Transplant status`,
    `Organ Care System`,
    #`AB0 mismatch`
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(-ID, as.character)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("ID")
annotation_df[is.na(annotation_df)] <- "No"

# Biuld heatmap matrix (ComplexHeatmap requires a matrix)
heatmap_mat <- matrix(1, nrow = 1, ncol = nrow(annotation_df))
colnames(heatmap_mat) <- rownames(annotation_df)
rownames(heatmap_mat) <- "Cohort"

#Create annotation legend list
top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = annotation_df,col = col_anno,
  
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    
    Diagnosis = list(title = "Diagnosis"),
    Sex = list(title = "Sex"),
    #`Shortterm Mechanical Support` = list(title = "Short-term MCS", at = c("Impella", "ECMO"), labels = c("Impella", "ECMO")),
    #Device = list(title = "Device", at = c("CRT-D", "ICD", "Life Vest"), labels = c("CRT-D", "ICD", "Life Vest")),
    `Pirche Classification` = list(title = "Pirche Classification", at = c("High risk", "Intermediate risk", "Low risk"), labels = c("High risk", "Intermediate risk", "Low risk")),
   # Diabetes = list(title = "Diabetes",at = c("Yes"),labels = c("Yes")),
  #  `Pulmonary hypertension` = list(title = "Pulmonary hypertension", at = c("Yes"), labels = c("Yes")),
  #  CKD = list(title = "CKD",at = c("Yes"),labels = c("Yes")),
    `Organ Care System` = list(title = "Organ Care System",at = c("Yes"),labels = c("Yes")),
    #`AB0 mismatch` = list(title = "AB0 mismatch",at = c("Yes"),labels = c("Yes")),
    `Sex mismatch` = list(title = "Sex mismatch",at = c("Yes"),labels = c("Yes")),
    `CMV Status` = list(title = "CMV Status",at = c("R+/D-", "R+/D+", "R-/D+","R-/D-"),labels = c("R+/D-", "R+/D+", "R-/D+","R-/D-")),
    `Transplantation risk score` = list(title = "Transplantation risk score",at = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),labels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"))
  )
)

  

#Create color mapping
# Create named color lists per variable
row_col_list <- list(
  Diagnosis = col_anno$Diagnosis,
  Sex = col_anno$Sex,
  `Shortterm Mechanical Support` = col_anno$`Shortterm Mechanical Support`,
  Device = col_anno$Device,
  Diabetes = col_anno$Diabetes,
  `Pirche Classification` = col_anno$`Pirche Classification`
)


# Plot Heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(heatmap_mat,name = "CarTrans", col = "white",
  
  top_annotation = top_ha,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  clustering_method_columns = "ward.D",
  
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  
  width = unit(18, "cm"),height = unit(4, "cm")
)

draw(ht,heatmap_legend_side = "right",annotation_legend_side = "bottom"
)

```
